recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast composition featuring a low-angle portrait of a man with a white beard against a stark white background, framed by bold blue geometric shapes at the top and a subtle vertical textured line on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the lower-left quadrant looking upward and outward.
Top-heavy color blocking using a deep blue triangular wedge.
Minimalist white negative space dominating the center and right.
Secondary inset graphic or sticker element in the upper-right corner.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the bottom-left third, cropped at the chest, creating a sense of stature.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark blue block at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's gaze, moves upward to the header text, then across to the inset graphic on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space used to separate the main subject from the graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Blue (Geometric shapes and header bar)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark clothing/blue shapes and the bright white environment.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Square dot separator between name and title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different weights or sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, square-ish proportions of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle portrait of a man with a grey beard in a dark sweater against a white background. Add a large cobalt blue triangular wedge in the top left corner and a thin, textured vertical line on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal blue bar at the very top. Place bold, uppercase, extended sans-serif text inside the bar, left-aligned. Add a rectangular inset graphic in the top right corner containing a group portrait and smaller text.

verificationChecks: Is the text left-aligned in the top bar?
Is the subject looking upward from a low angle?
Is the blue color a consistent cobalt/royal shade?
Is there significant white negative space in the center?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the blue background.
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Check that the geometric shapes do not overlap the subject's face.
Confirm the white background is pure and not off-white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle portrait + Geometric color blocking + Extended sans-serif header = 1980s Modernist Pop Aesthetic
